art_instructions: Set the scene in the cozy family dining room: cream walls, polished wooden plank floor, rounded archway in the back, and a sideboard with a warm cloth-shaded lamp glowing softly. Use a medium, eye-level composition with the round oak-brown table filling the lower half of the frame; sage-green placemats are on the table. The Owl sits on a mismatched wooden chair at the near side of the table, slightly left of center, facing slightly left; she has mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, and a small green scarf tied at her neck. Her tiny satchel hangs over the back of her chair. In front of her, on a simple white ceramic plate centered on a sage placemat, is a small, stylized gray mouse-shaped bread roll (smooth rounded body with two little ear shapes); the Owl leans forward with her beak open, taking a neat bite, with a few soft crumbs on the plate. Her expression is calm and focused, wings tucked, with one wingtip resting lightly on the table edge for balance. A plain wooden cup of water sits to the right of the plate, and an empty chair with a cream cushion is visible on the far side of the table. The lamplight is warm and gentle with soft shadows; no harsh light or clutter.
